articles.title: Max-severity Exchange server flaw under active exploitation by Kremlin hackers
articles.content: Exploits can give persistent server access that survives credential rotation and disk re-imaging.
articles.titleZh: 克里姆林宫黑客主动利用的Max-severity Exchange服务器漏洞
articles.contentZh: 漏洞利用可以提供在凭据循环和磁盘重新映像后仍然存在的持久服务器访问权限。

articles.title: Mythos attack on 3rd-round PQC algorithm candidate puts it out of commission
articles.content: HAWK withstood years of testing that had yet to uncover a fatal weakness found through Mythos.
articles.titleZh: 对第三轮PQC算法候选的神话攻击使其失效
articles.contentZh: 霍克经受住了多年的考验，这些考验尚未发现通过神话发现的致命弱点。

articles.title: We now have a better understanding how OpenAI hacked into Hugging Face
articles.content: 10 days passed from OpenAI models exploiting JFrog Artifactory 0-day to release of a patch.
articles.titleZh: 我们现在可以更好地了解OpenAI如何入侵Hugging Face
articles.contentZh: 从利用JFrog Artifactory的OpenAI模型0天到发布补丁，已经过去了10天。

articles.title: Now you can securely link multiple phones to one Signal account
articles.content: You can link more devices with one phone number on Signal now, including an Android phone or iPhone. Signal already supported linking PCs and iPads, but not additional phones.
